breve: Uniform set cache manager for Rendering Device based renderers.
descricao: Uniform set cache manager for RenderingDevice-based renderers. Provides a way to create a uniform set and reuse it in subsequent calls for as long as the uniform set exists. Uniform set will automatically be cleaned up when dependent objects are freed.

metodos.assinatura: get_cache(shader: RID, set: int, uniforms: RDUniform[]) -> RID static
metodos.desc: Creates/returns a cached uniform set based on the provided uniforms for a given shader.
